lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਵਸੰਦੜੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖੜੇ ਉਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man vasa(n)daRo sach sahu naanak habhe dukhaRe ulaahi ||2||
lines.translation: When the True Lord and Master abides in one's mind, O Nanak, all sins are dispelled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot aghaa sabh naas hohi simarat har naau ||
lines.translation: Millions of sins are totally erased, by meditating on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man chi(n)de phal paaeeahi har ke gun gaau ||
lines.translation: The fruits of one's heart's desires are obtained, by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran bhai kateeahi nihachal sach thaau ||
lines.translation: The fear of birth and death is eradicated, and one's eternal, unchanging true home is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab hovai likhiaa har charan samaau ||
lines.translation: If it is so pre-ordained, one is absorbed in the Lord's lotus feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakh lehu naanak bal jaau ||5||
lines.translation: Bless me with Your mercy, God - please preserve and save me! Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਆਦੰ ਰਸਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: grih rachanaa apaara(n) man bilaas suaada(n) rasah ||
lines.translation: They are involved in their beautiful houses, and the pleasures of the mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਦਾਂਚ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kadaa(n)ch nah simara(n)t naanak te ja(n)t bisataa krimah ||1||
lines.translation: They never remember the Lord in meditation; O Nanak, they are like maggots in manure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਚੁ ਅਡੰਬਰੁ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਨੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: much ada(n)bar habh kihu ma(n)jh muhabat neh ||
lines.translation: They are engrossed in ostentatious displays, lovingly attached to all their possessions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੈਂ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so saa(n)ee jai(n) visarai naanak so tan kheh ||2||
lines.translation: That body which forgets the Lord, O Nanak, shall be reduced to ashes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੇਜ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar sej anek sukh ras bhogan poore ||
lines.translation: He may enjoy a beautiful bed, countless pleasures and all sorts of enjoyments.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਇਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਲਾਇ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: grih soin cha(n)dan suga(n)dh laai motee heere ||
lines.translation: He may possess mansions of gold, studded with pearls and rubies, plastered with fragrant sandalwood oil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ichhe sukh maanadaa kichh naahi visoore ||
lines.translation: He may relish in the pleasures of his mind's desires, and have no anxiety at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh chit na aavaee visataa ke keere ||
lines.translation: But if he does not remember God, he is like a maggot in manure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na saa(n)t hoi kit bidh man dheere ||6||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all. How can the mind be comforted? ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਰਹੰ ਖੋਜੰਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal biraha(n) khoja(n)t bairaagee dah disah ||
lines.translation: One who loves the Lord's lotus feet searches for Him in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗੰਤ ਕਪਟ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tiaaga(n)t kapat roop maaiaa naanak aana(n)d roop saadh sa(n)gamah ||1||
lines.translation: He renounces the deceptive illusion of Maya, and joins the blissful form of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਉਚਰਾ ਵਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
lines.transliteration: man saa(n)ee mukh ucharaa vataa habhe lo ||
lines.translation: The Lord is in my mind, and with my mouth I chant His Name; I seek Him in all the lands of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜਿਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak habh ada(n)bar kooRiaa sun jeevaa sachee soi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, all ostentatious displays are false; hearing the Praises of the True Lord, I live. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸਤਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਝੁੰਪੜੀ ਚੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਛਿੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: basataa tootee jhu(n)paRee cheer sabh chhi(n)naa ||
lines.translation: He dwells in a broken-down shack, in tattered clothes,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਦਰੋ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਿੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaat na pat na aadaro udiaan bhrami(n)naa ||
lines.translation: with no social status, no honor and no respect; he wanders in the wilderness,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਇਠ ਧਨ ਰੂਪਹੀਣ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਸਿੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mitr na ith dhan roopaheen kichh saak na si(n)naa ||
lines.translation: with no friend or lover, without wealth, beauty, relatives or relations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajaa sagalee srisat kaa har naam man bhi(n)naa ||
lines.translation: Even so, he is the king of the whole world, if his mind is imbued with the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee dhooR man udharai prabh hoi suprasa(n)naa ||7||
lines.translation: With the dust of his feet, men are redeemed, because God is very pleased with him. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਰੂਪੰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਚਮਰ ਤਖਤ ਆਸਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik leelaa raaj ras roopa(n) chhatr chamar takhat aasana(n) ||
lines.translation: The various sorts of pleasures, powers, joys, beauty, canopies, cooling fans and thrones to sit on

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: racha(n)t mooR agiaan a(n)dhah naanak supan manorath maaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: - the foolish, ignorant and blind are engrossed in these things. O Nanak, desire for Maya is just a dream. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: supanai habh ra(n)g maaniaa mithaa lagaRaa mohu ||
lines.translation: In a dream, he enjoys all sorts of pleasures, and emotional attachment seems so sweet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihooneeaa su(n)dar maaiaa dhrohu ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the beauty of Maya's illusion is fake. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: supane setee chit moorakh laaiaa ||
lines.translation: The fool attaches his consciousness to the dream.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੇ ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜਾਗਤ ਭਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisare raaj ras bhog jaagat bhakhalaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When he awakes, he forgets the power, pleasures and enjoyments, and he is sad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਰਜਾ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aarajaa gaee vihaai dha(n)dhai dhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He passes his life chasing after worldly affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran bhae na kaam mohiaa maaiaa ||
lines.translation: His works are not completed, because he is enticed by Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa vechaaraa ja(n)t jaa aap bhulaaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: What can the poor helpless creature do? The Lord Himself has deluded him. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਲੋਕਹ ਜਿਤਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t svarag lokah jitate prithavee nav kha(n)danah ||
lines.translation: They may live in heavenly realms, and conquer the nine regions of the world,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭਰਮਣਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bisara(n)t har gopaalah naanak te praanee udiaan bharamanah ||1||
lines.translation: but if they forget the Lord of the world, O Nanak, they are just wanderers in the wilderness. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਤਕ ਕੋਡ ਤਮਾਸਿਆ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kautak kod tamaasiaa chit na aavas naau ||
lines.translation: In the midst of millions of games and entertainments, the Lord's Name does not come to their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋੜੀ ਨਰਕ ਬਰਾਬਰੇ ਉਜੜੁ ਸੋਈ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak koRee narak baraabare ujaR soee thaau ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, their home is like a wilderness, in the depths of hell. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਨਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa bhaiaan udiaan nagar kar maaniaa ||
lines.translation: He sees the terrible, awful wilderness as a city.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhooth samagree pekh sach kar jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the false objects, he believes them to be real.
